instruction: Open task-001_initial.scad and complete the parametric electronics-enclosure lower shell in millimetres. Preserve the centered outside envelope x=[-60,60], y=[-40,40], z=[0,28], with 3 mm side walls and a 4 mm floor; the open interior below the added features is therefore x=[-57,57], y=[-37,37], z=[4,28]. Add four vertical screw bosses centered at (-45,-25), (-45,25), (45,-25), and (45,25). Each boss occupies z=[4,28], has an 8 mm outside diameter, and contains a concentric 3.6 mm diameter pilot hole cut vertically through z=[0,28]. Cut three rounded slots vertically through the floor over z=[0,4], centered at (0,-25), (0,0), and (0,25). Each slot is oriented along X, has an overall length of 48 mm and width of 6 mm, and has semicircular ends of radius 3 mm, so each slot spans x=[-24,24] and y=[center_y-3,center_y+3]. Add exactly seven rectangular ribs centered at x=-42,-28,-14,0,14,28,42 mm. Each rib is 1.6 mm thick along X, 64 mm long over y=[-32,32], and 14 mm high over z=[4,18]. Add a centered rectangular lid ledge over z=[18,28], with outside outline 106 x 66 mm (x=[-53,53], y=[-33,33]), uniform 2 mm wall thickness, and inside opening 102 x 62 mm (x=[-51,51], y=[-31,31]). Union the shell, bosses, ribs, and ledge into one connected solid; the ribs must meet the floor and the ledge. Do not add other geometry. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-001_output.stl.
